title: Halal-cart chicken and rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil, plus more for cooking
Shredded lettuce, tomato, pita, and hot sauce
steps: Blend lemon, oregano, garlic, oil, salt, and pepper. Marinate chicken 1–4 hours.
Brown chicken in a skillet; finish at 165°F. Chop into chunks and return to pan juices.
Cook rice with butter, turmeric, and broth until tender.
Stir mayo, yogurt, sugar, vinegar, salt, and a splash of lemon for white sauce.
Serve chicken over yellow rice with salad, pita, white sauce, and hot sauce.
